# Download the Kenyan Administrative boundaries

```{r}
# Kenya administrative boundaries
kenya_adm2 <- geodata::gadm(
  country = "KEN",
  level = 2,
  path = "01_data/boundary"
)


kenya_adm2
names(kenya_adm2)
sort(unique(kenya_adm2$NAME_2))

grep(
  "Tharaka",
  unique(kenya_adm2$NAME_2),
  value = TRUE
)

```

# Extract Tharaka subcounty and save the shape file

```{r}

tharaka <- kenya_adm2[
  kenya_adm2$NAME_2 == "Tharaka",
]

plot(tharaka, col="lightgreen", labels="Tharaka")


writeVector(
  tharaka,
  "01_data/boundary/Tharaka_SubCounty.shp",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

expanse(
  tharaka,
  unit = "km"
)

sort(
  unique(
    kenya_adm2$NAME_2[
      kenya_adm2$NAME_1 == "Tharaka-Nithi"
    ]
  )
)

study_area <- tharaka

plot(study_area)


bbox <- ext(study_area)
bbox

saveRDS(
  study_area,
  "01_data/boundary/tharaka_study_area.rds"
)



study_area_sf <- st_as_sf(study_area)

study_area_sf


```
# Get the boundaries

```{r}


crs(tharaka)
```
```{r}
bbox <- st_bbox(st_as_sf(study_area))

bbox

bbox_vec <- c(
  bbox["xmin"],
  bbox["ymin"],
  bbox["xmax"],
  bbox["ymax"]
)

stac_obj <- stac(
  "https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1"
)
```

```{r}
items_2000 <- stac_obj |>
  stac_search(
    collections = "landsat-c2-l2",
    bbox = bbox_vec,
    datetime = "2000-02-10/2000-02-20"
  ) |>
  get_request()

length(items_2000$features)
# items_2000$features[[1]]$properties
```

```{r}

# =========================================================
# 1. IDENTIFY THARAKA SUB-COUNTY
# =========================================================

library(rgee)

# Use the existing Earth Engine connection
gaul2 <- ee$FeatureCollection("FAO/GAUL/2015/level2")

# Approximate search area around Tharaka
search_area <- ee$Geometry$Rectangle(
  c(37.6, -0.8, 38.7, 0.5)
)

# Find administrative units in the search area
nearby_units <- gaul2$filterBounds(search_area)

# Inspect candidate administrative names
admin_names <- nearby_units$
  select(c("ADM0_NAME", "ADM1_NAME", "ADM2_NAME"))$
  getInfo()

print(admin_names)

```
